$comment: Copy to deploy/config.json (git-ignored) and replace every <...> value. Dataverse and Azure may be in different Entra tenants.
$installComment: managed = customer environment, imports the released managed solution (recommended). source = development environment, builds schema from code (unmanaged).

solution.$comment: Optional path to VerifiedResolutionLedger_<version>_managed.zip. Empty = newest file in artifacts/solution.

openAi.$comment: Existing Azure OpenAI / Foundry account in the same resource group. Leave accountName empty to use the built-in local embeddings.

adapter.$comment: Contact Center adapter. Set the same values as Function App settings Vrl__Adapter__<name> so the pipeline and CLI replays agree.

testChat.$comment: Optional. From your chat widgets' code snippets (Copilot Service admin center > Channels > Chat > widget > Copy code).
testChat.humanWidgetAppId: <data-app-id of a workstream WITHOUT an AI agent>
testChat.botWidgetAppId: <data-app-id of a workstream WITH your Copilot Studio agent>
